set_aside.subject: clock.monotonic_ns deadline comparison
set_aside.text: “asks whether it passed with a later reading”
set_aside.question: Does a bounded wait expire when the later reading is equal to the deadline or only when it is greater, and must a final reading be taken before accepting an otherwise successful completion?
options: Expire when later_reading >= deadline and check before accepting completion
Expire only when later_reading > deadline and check before accepting completion
Let each caller or underlying wait primitive decide
set_aside.default_guess: Expire when later_reading >= deadline and take a final reading before accepting completion.

set_aside.subject: sandbox wall-deadline origin
set_aside.text: “the reading at the start plus the bound”
set_aside.question: For sandbox.execute_function, which event is “the start”: before creating the isolated environment, immediately before starting the runner process, or when user code begins, and does confirmed cleanup have to finish before the deadline?
options: Count environment creation, runner execution and cleanup
Start immediately before launching the runner and exclude cleanup
Count only execution of user code
set_aside.default_guess: Start immediately before launching the runner process; enforce the bound through runner completion, with cleanup performed afterward under the separate cleanup rule.

set_aside.subject: HTTP transport-deadline origin and scope
set_aside.text: “The caller derives a bounded wait's deadline from it — the reading at the start plus the bound”
set_aside.question: For service_invoker.send_prepared_request, exactly when is the initial reading taken and which phases must complete before the deadline: DNS, connection, TLS, request transmission, response headers and response body?
options: Take the reading on entry to send_prepared_request and apply one total deadline through the complete response body
Start after connection establishment and cover only request transmission and response
Give each transport phase its own transport_timeout_ms bound
set_aside.default_guess: Take one reading on entry to send_prepared_request and apply one total deadline through receipt of the complete bounded response body.
